edges.reason: Player must locate the sandstone stairs structure before mining its stair blocks with the pickaxe
Red nether brick wall is built into the sandstone structure's back wall; must find area first
Magenta wool blocks are embedded as accents in the dark oak stairs structure; must locate it first
Cyan concrete is further along the same northward path; orange concrete area must be traversed first to reach cyan
Llamas are on the trading platform just beyond the cyan concrete markers at the end of the path
Llama indicates wandering trader presence on the platform; trader is needed to sell Blue Dye
Llama indicates wandering trader presence on the platform; trader is needed to buy Leather Pants
Must sell blue dye first so emerald count threshold (>=33) triggers correctly before spending emeralds on leather pants

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task (preferred rule type per design philosophy). The dark oak stairs structure is centered at (15, 1, 18) spawn-relative, ~22 blocks from spawn. Max_distance=5 requires genuine navigation. Facing_tolerance=60 ensures player is looking at the structure.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The sandstone stairs structure is centered at (-15, 1, 20) spawn-relative, ~25 blocks from spawn. Max_distance=5 requires genuine navigation to the northwest.

Uses inventory_has because mining magenta wool drops the block item into inventory. Wool drops itself when broken by any tool or hand. Player starts with 0 magenta_wool, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining.
Uses inventory_has because mining sandstone stairs with a pickaxe drops the item into inventory. Player has diamond pickaxe and starts with 0 sandstone_stairs. Only drops when mined with a pickaxe.

Uses inventory_has because mining red nether brick wall with a pickaxe drops the item into inventory. Player has diamond pickaxe and starts with 0 red_nether_brick_wall. Only drops when mined with a pickaxe.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The orange concrete markers are centered at (6, 0, 30) spawn-relative, ~30 blocks from spawn. Max_distance=5 requires walking to the markers.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cyan concrete markers are centered at (9, 0, 38) spawn-relative, ~39 blocks from spawn. Max_distance=5 requires walking further north along the path.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The llamas (NoAI, stationary) are on the trading platform centered at (10, 1, 45) spawn-relative, ~46 blocks from spawn. Max_distance=5 requires reaching the platform.

Uses inventory_has because selling blue dye to the wandering trader gives the player an emerald. Player starts with exactly 32 emeralds. After selling 1 blue dye, player has 33 emeralds. The dependency graph enforces this happens before buying leather pants (which costs 4 emeralds). Checking emerald >= 33 confirms the sell trade occurred and cannot false-trigger since no other emerald sources exist in this scene.

Uses inventory_has because trading for leather pants (leather_leggings) results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. Player starts with 0 leather_leggings, so having at least 1 confirms the trade was completed with the wandering trader.

scene_description: An expanded exploration and trading scene spanning ~50 blocks. Player spawns on a small stone brick platform at the origin. To the northeast (~22 blocks away) is a dark oak stairs structure with magenta wool accents. To the northwest (~25 blocks away) is a sandstone stairs structure with red nether brick wall backing. Heading north, orange concrete markers appear at ~28-32 blocks out, followed by cyan concrete markers at ~36-40 blocks, leading to a trading platform at ~45 blocks north with a persistent wandering trader (custom trades for blue dye and leather pants) and two stationary llamas.
task_text: Explore the area to find structures and landmarks. Find and mine magenta wool from the dark oak structure to the northeast. Find and mine sandstone stairs and red nether brick wall from the sandstone structure to the northwest. Follow the colored concrete path north — find orange concrete markers, then cyan concrete markers. Locate the llama and wandering trader at the trading platform. Sell your Blue Dye to the trader, then trade emeralds for Leather Pants.
design_notes: Final validated design targeting Minecraft 1.20.4. Layout: spawn at origin with stone brick platform. NE branch: dark oak structure with magenta wool at (~15, ~1, ~18), ~22 blocks from spawn. NW branch: sandstone structure with red nether brick wall at (~-15, ~1, ~20), ~25 blocks from spawn. North path: orange concrete at (~6, 0, ~30), cyan concrete at (~9, 0, ~38), trading platform at (~10, 0, ~45). All entities persist (PersistenceRequired:1b) and llamas are frozen (NoAI:1b). Wandering trader has custom trades: blue_dye→emerald and 4 emeralds→leather_leggings. Player equipped with diamond pickaxe, shears, 4 blue dye, and 32 emeralds.
